prayerExcerpt.en-US: It is not a man's condition, but virtue, that can make him truly great or truly happy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Não é a condição de um homem, mas a virtude, que pode torná-lo verdadeiramente grande ou verdadeiramente feliz.

meta.face: An Egyptian of about thirty-five with a warm, DEEP-BROWN complexion and a ROUND, FULL face with FLESHY cheeks and a BROAD, rounded jaw, after a Roman-Egyptian mummy portrait — a LOW, rounded forehead under short, thick, close-cropped black hair; THICK, straight black brows; LARGE, dark, HEAVY-LIDDED eyes with a mild, patient look, lifted a little; a BROAD nose with a rounded tip and wide nostrils; a FULL, soft, closed mouth; a SHORT, DENSE black beard trimmed close along the jaw and chin. Not the lean, angular nemesion, the kite-shaped julian_basilissa or the long pachomius.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The face is modelled on an encaustic Fayum mummy portrait of a man in the British Museum (a round, full face, close-cropped black hair and a short black beard), the look of Roman Egypt in his century; his dress and tablets follow Dionysius of Alexandria's letter in Eusebius, where he keeps a magistrate's accounts for hire.
